item.title: [Itrfoundation] Iowa Voters Reject More Than $561 Million in Local Bond Proposals
item.description:
Voters approved 19 of 46 bond proposals on the November ballot, including several large school and municipal projects. The 41.3% bond passage rate was similar to November 2025’s rate of just over 43%, but well below the 59% passage rate in Iowa’s March 2023 special bond election. Since Iowa moved bond elections to November, approval rates have generally been lower than in earlier elections. Higher costs and inflation may also be influencing voters’ decisions.

The post Iowa Voters Reject More Than $561 Million in Local Bond Proposals appeared first on ITR Foundation.
